content_sections.heading: Goa College of Agriculture Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Goa College of Agriculture Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for Goa College of Agriculture?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Assistant Professor posts at Goa College of Agriculture is scheduled for 05 October 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on this date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Assistant Professor posts. These include 2 positions for Assistant Professor in Agronomy and 1 position for Assistant Professor (Farm Manager).

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for these Assistant Professor positions at Goa College of Agriculture.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for the Assistant Professor roles?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Professor positions at Goa College of Agriculture will be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q5. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Goa College of Agriculture office, located in Old Goa, Goa, with the pincode 403402.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for these Assistant Professor positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these Assistant Professor positions at Goa College of Agriculture is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age relaxation mentioned for the candidates?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limits or age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any such information.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of Goa College of Agriculture?
faq.answer: The official website of Goa College of Agriculture is https://goacollegeofagriculture.edu.in/. Candidates can visit this website for more information and updates.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Goa College of Agriculture recruitment is 4/4/SAMETI/GCA/RECRUITMENT/2026-27/899.
